decisions.reason: As a newly launched supplement with a dedicated page, it appears to have enough strategic support and, given the firm's size and slack, its uncertain early results are likely to be tolerated for another year.

This product received especially visible launch marketing and is close to the firm's pharmacy-oriented health portfolio, so management would likely keep it while learning whether it can reach aspiration levels.
Although it had less prominent presentation than A or B, it is still an adjacent self-care product and a large established firm would usually allow more time before judging it below aspiration.
Its narrower niche and lighter website presence make it more uncertain, but organizational slack and the exploratory nature of supplement launches still favor keeping it for now.

The explicit 2018 problem notice suggests a regulatory or quality shortfall in a competitive generic product, making it more likely that management will redeploy resources rather than continue carrying a troubled launch.
